name: speech-to-text
description: Transcribe audio (wav/mp3/m4a/ogg/aac/amr/silk/flac/webm/opus) using Lumos cloud ASR. Returns the path to a spooled transcript file (under ~/.lumos/transcripts/) — the model uses Read on that path to get the text, keeping the context flat for long recordings. Same engine that auto-transcribes WeChat voice messages.
